setup.description: Ensure flipt is installed and verified, reusing an available matching version, and publish its environment.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

run.description: Run any Flipt CLI command as literal native arguments.

project.description: Working directory containing the source checkout; defaults to the current directory. Default: ".".

runDir.description: Fresh directory for this invocation’s execution report and task logs; must not already exist.

executable.description: Native CLI executable name or absolute path; defaults to this operation’s tool.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum task duration in milliseconds; defaults to 900000. Default: 900000.

artifacts.description: Comma-separated NAME=PATH output artifacts; use CSV double quotes around entries containing commas.

arguments.description: Native Flipt command and argument tokens as comma-separated text; never JSON objects or arrays.
